diagram.title: Buffer lifetime through prologue, steady state, and drain
diagram.prediction: Which slot can receive tile k+1 while the compute stage still reads tile k?
diagram.reading: The code declares input pipeline buffers through spec with pl.Buffered(buffer_count=buffers) and output_spec with pl.Buffered(buffer_count=2). The actual references are x_hbm, y_hbm, and out_hbm. An input slot is reusable only after axpy_body has consumed that tile; an output slot is reusable only after its store is complete. Buffer letters A and B denote alternating slots, not named variables in the Pallas API.
diagram.alt: Prologue loads tile 0 into input slot A. During steady state, compute consumes x[k], y[k] from one slot while the next tile loads into the other; out[k] is stored after compute. Drain finishes the last compute and store before any slot is reused.
diagram.scope: Schematic schedule of buffer lifetimes; stage overlap is illustrative, not measured.
